page.overview:
Who is Bug-Eye?

Kid Omni-Man|enemies=Capvincible † (victim) Hairvincible † (victim)}}

Bug-Eye is a human superhero with a bug-themed outfit.

Bug-Eye has oversized, dark red bug-like compound eyes. She has a glowing green lens or gem on her forehead, from which she projects a powerful energy beam. Insect-like transparent wings protrude from her back, allowing her to fly swiftly. Her costume is somewhat dark, black with a deep shade of purple. She has a sleek, techy, alien look.

Bug-Eye's history largely remains unknown.
